name: Behavior FSM
description: Finite state machine for autonomous entity behavior across idle, moving, attacking, fleeing, gathering, and patrolling. Its only output channel is a command request on the command bus, so it never mutates entities directly. Categorised as utility rather than movement because it governs engagement and gathering, not locomotion alone.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

outputs.name: detectionRange
outputs.description: How far this entity notices a target, republished so the components that ACT on noticing can read it. It was an input only, which meant a real-time executor had no way to ask and pursued from anywhere on the map — a wolf that starts running at you from thirty tiles away is not a predator, it is a homing missile. Published rather than duplicated as a second input elsewhere, because two numbers for one idea is two numbers that will disagree.

outputs.name: behavior
outputs.description: The current behaviour name. Published beside `states` because a reader almost always wants just this, and digging it out of a status object is how a caller ends up depending on the shape of a debug readout.
